title: Bali: 35 Days of Adventure, Street Food & Island Magic on a Shoestring
description: An epic month-long Bali adventure built for a solo traveler who craves adventure, incredible food, deep relaxation, and vibrant nightlife — all for under $1,000. From rice terraces to volcanic sunrises, hidden waterfalls to beach clubs, this itinerary covers every corner of the Island of the Gods.

days.title: Arrival in Paradise — Kuta Beach & First Bali Sunset
days.description: Land at Ngurah Rai Airport, settle into your guesthouse, grab your first plate of nasi goreng, and watch a legendary Bali sunset on Kuta Beach.

activities.name: ✈️ Arrive at Ngurah Rai International Airport (DPS)
activities.description: Welcome to Bali! After immigration and customs, grab a local SIM card at the airport (Telkomsel or XL — 50,000-100,000 IDR for 15-30GB). Exchange a small amount of cash or use the BCA ATM in arrivals. Take a Grab to your accommodation — much cheaper than airport taxis. Drop your bags and take a walk around Kuta. It's touristy but it's a great base for your first few days — cheap accommodation, close to the airport, and tons of food options. Poppies Lane 1 & 2 are the backpacker heartbeat of Kuta.

activities.name: 🌅 Kuta Beach Sunset
activities.description: Bali's most accessible sunset spot. Grab a Bintang beer from a beach vendor (25,000 IDR), plant yourself on the sand, and watch the sky explode in oranges and pinks. The beach hawkers can be persistent — a firm 'no thank you' works. This is your first Bali sunset of many.

days.title: Seminyak Beach Clubs, Street Art & Night Out
days.description: Explore Bali's trendiest neighborhood — boutique shopping, world-class beach clubs, incredible street food, and your first taste of Bali nightlife.

activities.name: 🛵 Rent a Scooter & Head to Seminyak
activities.description: Negotiate a monthly scooter rental — aim for 900,000-1,200,000 IDR ($58-78) for the full month. Your freedom machine for the next 35 days. Seminyak is 20 minutes north of Kuta along the coast road. Jalan Kayu Aya (Eat Street) and surrounding lanes are packed with indie boutiques, surf shops, and colorful street murals. Great for photos and window shopping. The vibe here is much more upscale than Kuta.

activities.name: 🏖️ Seminyak Beach Stroll
activities.description: Walk along the sand from Seminyak south toward Double Six Beach. The beach is wide, the waves are dramatic, and you'll pass dozens of beach bars offering bean bags and cold drinks. Find a spot, order a coconut (15,000 IDR), and chill. Iconic colorful bean bag beach bar right on Seminyak Beach. No entry fee — just order a drink. Grab a bean bag, watch the sunset, and soak in the atmosphere. It's the most Instagrammable budget sunset spot in Seminyak.

activities.name: 🍸 Jl. Petitenget Bar Hop
activities.description: Seminyak has Bali's most upscale nightlife. Start with happy hour cocktails at Motel Mexicola (free-spirited Mexican-themed bar), then wander to Red Ruby for craft cocktails. End at Mirror Lounge if you want to dance until late.

days.title: Tanah Lot Temple & Canggu Introduction
days.description: Visit Bali's most iconic sea temple at sunset, then discover Canggu — the laid-back surf village that will become your home base for the next week.

activities.name: 🛵 Ride to Canggu & Check In
activities.description: Pack up from Kuta and ride 40 minutes north to Canggu. This surf-centric village is the epicenter of solo traveler life in Bali — affordable, social, and perfectly positioned between Seminyak nightlife and Ubud's culture. Batu Bolong area is the sweet spot for budget stays. Canggu's main beach. Watch the surfers while you settle in. The black sand is volcanic and gets scorching hot by midday — wear flip flops. Great beginner surf breaks if you want to try tomorrow.

activities.name: 🛕 Tanah Lot Temple (Pura Tanah Lot)
activities.description: Bali's most photographed temple, perched on a rocky islet surrounded by crashing waves. At low tide you can walk across to the temple base (non-Hindus can't enter the temple itself). The sunset here is absolutely spectacular — arrive by 4:30 PM for a good viewing spot. After the main temple, walk along the cliff path to find a holy spring where a priest will bless you with holy water (small donation). The entire coastline is dramatic black volcanic rock with crashing Indian Ocean waves.

days.title: Surf Lessons, Rice Field Walk & Canggu Night Market
days.description: Learn to surf at beginner-friendly Batu Bolong, walk through emerald rice paddies, and feast at the famous Canggu Night Market.

activities.name: 🏄 Beginner Surf Lesson at Batu Bolong
activities.description: Canggu is one of the best places in the world to learn surfing. Batu Bolong's consistent, gentle waves are perfect for beginners. A 2-hour group lesson includes board, rash guard, and an instructor who'll have you standing by session's end.

activities.name: 🌾 Canggu Rice Paddy Walk
activities.description: Behind the cafés and surf shops, Canggu still has beautiful rice terraces. The Pererenan rice fields offer a peaceful walk through emerald green paddies with mountain views in the background. Free, quiet, and incredibly photogenic.

activities.name: 🌙 Canggu Night Market (Pasar Malam)
activities.description: Every Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday evening, the Canggu Night Market comes alive with dozens of food stalls. This is where budget eating reaches its peak — satay skewers, martabak (stuffed pancakes), grilled corn, fresh juices. An entire feast for under 50,000 IDR ($3.20).

days.title: Echo Beach Surf, Canggu Temple & Sunset Bars
days.description: Explore Canggu's wilder surf beach, visit a dramatic sea temple, and hit the legendary sunset bars that make this village famous.

activities.name: 🌊 Echo Beach
activities.description: Canggu's most dramatic beach — bigger waves, black volcanic sand, and a raw, untamed vibe. Watch experienced surfers tackle the powerful break or just enjoy the scenery from the beach cafés perched on the cliff edge. Small but atmospheric temple right on the rocks at Echo Beach. Often overlooked by tourists heading to the sand. Beautiful spot for photos with crashing waves as backdrop.

activities.name: 🌅 Finns Beach Club — Sunset Session
activities.description: One of Bali's most famous beach clubs. The trick: visit during happy hour or use the free beach area (no minimum spend) adjacent to the club. Watch the sunset with the beautiful people without the beautiful price tag. THE backpacker bar in Canggu. Cheap drinks, live music, pool tables, and packed every night. This is where you'll meet other solo travelers. Wednesday and Saturday nights are the biggest parties.

days.title: Canggu to Ubud — Monkey Forest & Ubud Market
days.description: Ride into the cultural heart of Bali. Explore the Sacred Monkey Forest, wander the famous Ubud Art Market, and settle into the town that captures every traveler's soul.

activities.name: 🛵 Scenic Ride: Canggu to Ubud
activities.description: A beautiful 1-hour ride through rice paddies and small villages. The landscape transforms from coastal surf vibes to lush jungle highlands. Stop whenever something catches your eye — roadside temples, rice terraces, local markets.

activities.name: 🐒 Sacred Monkey Forest Sanctuary (Mandala Suci Wenara Wana)
activities.description: Over 1,000 long-tailed macaques live in this ancient forest filled with towering banyan trees, moss-covered temples, and dragon stairways. The monkeys are bold — secure your belongings. Walking through the forest feels like entering another world. A labyrinth of stalls selling handmade Balinese crafts — woven bags, silk scarves, paintings, wood carvings, incense, jewelry. Bargaining is expected. Start at 30-40% of the asking price and settle around 50-60%.

activities.name: 🏛️ Ubud Royal Palace (Puri Saren Agung)
activities.description: The historical palace in the heart of Ubud. Beautiful traditional Balinese architecture. Every evening at 7:30 PM, traditional Balinese dance performances are held in the palace courtyard — Legong, Barong, or Ramayana ballet. Attending a performance here is one of Bali's most magical experiences.

days.title: Tegallalang Rice Terraces & Balinese Cooking Class
days.description: Visit Bali's most iconic rice terraces, swing over the jungle canopy, and learn to cook authentic Balinese dishes in a hands-on cooking class.

activities.name: 🌾 Tegallalang Rice Terraces
activities.description: Bali's most famous rice terraces — dramatic carved steps of emerald green cascading down a valley. The subak irrigation system is UNESCO-recognized. Walk the paths between the paddies and marvel at the engineering that's fed Bali for a thousand years. If you're up for it, the famous Bali Swing is here — soar over the jungle canopy. Multiple operators offer swings at different heights and prices. The views are exhilarating.

activities.name: 👨‍🍳 Balinese Cooking Class with Market Visit
activities.description: One of the best experiences in Ubud. A half-day class starts with a trip to a traditional morning market to buy ingredients, then you cook 5-7 Balinese dishes: sate lilit, lawar, nasi goreng, sambal matah, and more. You eat everything you cook. Most classes include recipes to take home.

activities.name: 🌙 Evening Walk on Jl. Hanoman
activities.description: Ubud's other main street — quieter and more artsy than Jl. Raya Ubud. Browse yoga studios, organic cafés, and bookshops. Pick up a book at Ganesha Bookshop (Bali's best English-language bookstore) and wind down after your cooking adventure.

days.title: Tirta Empul Holy Springs & Gunung Kawi Temple
days.description: Experience Bali's most sacred water temple — a spiritual purification ritual in ancient spring waters — and descend into the dramatic rock-carved temple of Gunung Kawi.

activities.name: 🛕 Tirta Empul Holy Water Temple
activities.description: Bali's most sacred water temple where Balinese Hindus come for melukat (spiritual purification). You can participate — wade into the pools and move through 13 fountains, letting sacred spring water wash over you while offering a prayer at each. It's profound, even if you're not religious. Ancient 11th-century temple carved directly into rock faces along a river valley. You descend 300+ stone steps through rice paddies to reach towering 7-meter carved shrines — royal tombs of King Anak Wungsu. One of Bali's most dramatic and least crowded major temples.

activities.name: 💆 Affordable Balinese Massage
activities.description: Ubud is famous for incredibly affordable, skilled massages. A 1-hour traditional Balinese massage costs 80,000-120,000 IDR ($5-8) — a fraction of Western prices. Treat yourself after all those temple stairs. Ubud's most beautiful free activity. A narrow ridge path between two valleys of palm trees and tall grass. The sunset views over the valleys are stunning. It's a gentle 2km out-and-back walk.

days.title: Mount Batur Sunrise Trek ☀️🌋
days.description: The bucket-list Bali experience — climb an active volcano in the dark and watch the sun rise over the caldera lake, then enjoy eggs cooked in volcanic steam.

activities.name: 🌋 Mount Batur Sunrise Trek
activities.description: Wake at 1:30 AM for a 2 AM pickup. Drive to the trailhead and begin the 2-hour hike up the 1,717m active volcano in darkness with headlamps. Reach the summit just as the sun explodes over Mount Agung and Lake Batur below. Your guide cooks eggs and bananas in volcanic steam vents. This is THE definitive Bali experience.

activities.name: ♨️ Toya Devasya Natural Hot Springs
activities.description: Soak your aching muscles in natural volcanic hot springs overlooking Lake Batur. Multiple pools at different temperatures, an infinity pool, and stunning caldera views. Pure bliss after the trek.

activities.name: 😴 Recovery Evening
activities.description: You started at 1:30 AM — you've earned a quiet evening. Return to Ubud, shower, nap, then stroll to a warung for a relaxed dinner. Maybe grab a Bintang and journaling session.

days.title: Ubud Free Day — Yoga, Waterfalls & Art Galleries
days.description: A relaxed day to explore at your own pace — try a yoga class, chase waterfalls, or lose yourself in Ubud's world-class art galleries.

activities.name: 🧘 Morning Yoga Class
activities.description: Ubud is the yoga capital of Asia. Drop into a class at Yoga Barn or Radiantly Alive — they welcome all levels. Practicing yoga in an open-air shala surrounded by jungle sounds is a uniquely Bali experience. If waterfalls > yoga, ride 30 minutes south to Tegenungan — a powerful, thundering waterfall you can swim under. Less crowded in the morning. The descent is steep but well-maintained with concrete stairs.

activities.name: 🎨 ARMA Museum (Agung Rai Museum of Art)
activities.description: World-class museum showcasing Balinese and Indonesian art from the 16th century to present, set in beautiful tropical gardens. Features works by Walter Spies, the German artist who defined Ubud's artistic identity in the 1930s. Peaceful and uncrowded. Free rice terrace walk through Ubud's organic farms. Less touristy than Tegallalang, more authentic, and beautiful at sunset. Ends at Sari Organik restaurant perched above the paddies.

days.title: Hidden Waterfalls of North Bali & Munduk Highlands
days.description: Leave Ubud for the misty highlands of Munduk — Bali's hidden gem. Chase twin waterfalls through jungle trails and sleep in the cool mountain air above coffee plantations.

activities.name: 🛵 Scenic Ride: Ubud to Munduk
activities.description: A stunning 2-hour ride through the highlands. The road climbs from rice paddies through coffee and clove plantations, past twin lakes (Buyan and Tamblingan), into the misty mountain village of Munduk. Some of the most beautiful driving in all of Bali. Stop at the viewpoint overlooking Lake Buyan and Lake Tamblingan — two volcanic crater lakes surrounded by dense jungle. On clear mornings the mirror reflections are stunning.

activities.name: 💧 Munduk Waterfall
activities.description: A beautiful 15-meter waterfall hidden in coffee plantation jungle. The trail is a gentle 15-minute walk through tropical forest. The fall plunges into a small pool — refreshing in the highland mist. Often completely empty. Just 10 minutes further down the trail from Munduk Waterfall, and less visited. A taller, more powerful cascade in a dramatic mossy gorge. The jungle setting is primordial.

activities.name: ☕ Munduk Coffee Plantation Walk
activities.description: Munduk is famous for its coffee (both Arabica and Robusta) and clove plantations. Take an evening stroll through the plantations as the mist rolls in. Some guesthouses offer free coffee tours. The scent of cloves in the cool evening air is intoxicating.

days.title: Sekumpul Waterfall — Bali's Most Beautiful
days.description: Trek to the waterfall that even Balinese consider the island's most beautiful — a twin cascade plunging 80 meters through pristine jungle.

activities.name: 💧 Sekumpul Waterfall
activities.description: Widely considered the most beautiful waterfall in Bali — and it earns every bit of the title. Twin 80-meter cascades plunge through a jungle canyon into a crystal pool. The trek down is adventurous: 300+ steep steps, river crossings, and jungle paths. The reward is otherworldly. After Sekumpul, ride back to Ubud via the eastern highland road. Stop at viewpoints overlooking Mount Agung. The ride is long (2.5 hours) but stunning.

days.title: Ubud Free Day — Art, Spa & Sunset Ritual
days.description: A slow day in Ubud before heading to the islands. Explore art galleries, get a luxury massage for cheap, or simply wander the rice paddies with no agenda.

activities.name: 🎨 Neka Art Museum
activities.description: Five pavilions showcasing the evolution of Balinese art from traditional to contemporary. Set in beautiful gardens with valley views. The kris (dagger) collection is fascinating. Splurge on a 2-hour spa package — Balinese massage, body scrub, and flower bath for around 250,000-350,000 IDR ($16-23). In most countries this would cost $150+. Ubud quality is excellent.

days.title: Ubud to Sanur — Nusa Penida Prep
days.description: Ride to the coastal town of Sanur — departure point for Nusa Penida. A chill beach day before tomorrow's island adventure.

activities.name: 🛵 Ride to Sanur
activities.description: 1-hour ride from Ubud to Sanur, Bali's original resort town. More relaxed and less chaotic than Kuta or Seminyak. The beach is calm (protected by a reef) and perfect for swimming. A paved beachfront path runs the entire length of Sanur — perfect for a sunset stroll. The beach faces east (sunrise beach!) with calm turquoise water. Local art markets and small cafés line the path.

days.title: Nusa Penida — Kelingking Beach & Crystal Bay
days.description: Fast boat to Bali's most dramatic island. See the iconic T-Rex clifftop of Kelingking Beach, swim at Angel's Billabong, and sunset at Crystal Bay.

activities.name: 🚤 Fast Boat: Sanur to Nusa Penida
activities.description: 45-minute fast boat ride across the Badung Strait. The crossing can be rough — take motion sickness pills if you're prone. You'll arrive at Toya Pakeh harbor on Nusa Penida's north coast.

activities.name: 🦕 Kelingking Beach (T-Rex Cliff)
activities.description: Bali's single most iconic viewpoint — a cliff shaped like a T-Rex dinosaur plunging into turquoise water. The view from the top is jaw-dropping. You CAN descend to the beach below (30-45 min, very steep and dangerous path) but the view from the top is the main event. Two natural wonders next to each other. Angel's Billabong is a natural infinity pool carved into the rock with crystal-clear water (swim at LOW TIDE only — waves at high tide are deadly). Broken Beach is a dramatic archway bridge over a circular cove. Both free.

activities.name: 🌅 Crystal Bay Sunset
activities.description: Nusa Penida's best sunset beach. A sheltered cove with calm water, white sand, and a perfect westward view. Swim in the crystal-clear water then watch the sun set behind a small offshore island. This is paradise.

days.title: Nusa Penida — East Coast & Manta Snorkeling
days.description: Explore the dramatic east coast — Diamond Beach, Atuh Beach — then snorkel with giant manta rays at Manta Point.

activities.name: 💎 Diamond Beach
activities.description: A stunning white sand beach at the bottom of dramatic limestone cliffs. The stairway down is carved into the cliff face with a diamond-shaped rock formation at the base. One of Bali's most photogenic beaches. Adjacent to Diamond Beach — a secluded cove with dramatic cliff formations, arch rocks offshore, and pristine turquoise water. Feels like a secret paradise. Small beach bars serve coconuts and snacks.

activities.name: 🐙 Manta Point Snorkeling
activities.description: Snorkel with giant oceanic manta rays — wingspan up to 5 meters! Boats depart from various beaches. The mantas glide gracefully below you in the clear water. One of the most incredible wildlife encounters in Southeast Asia.

days.title: Nusa Penida to Uluwatu — Bukit Peninsula
days.description: Say goodbye to Nusa Penida, fast boat back to Bali, and head straight to the dramatic clifftop world of Uluwatu on the Bukit Peninsula.

activities.name: 🚤 Fast Boat: Nusa Penida to Sanur
activities.description: Morning fast boat back to Sanur. From there, ride your scooter (or Grab) south to Uluwatu — about 1.5 hours along the coast road. The landscape shifts dramatically from lush green to arid limestone cliffs.

activities.name: 🛕 Uluwatu Temple (Pura Luhur Uluwatu)
activities.description: Spectacular 11th-century temple perched on a 70-meter cliff above the Indian Ocean. The setting is impossibly dramatic. Monkeys here are notorious thieves — they'll snatch glasses, hats, and phones. Secure EVERYTHING. 100+ men chanting 'cak cak cak' in concentric circles while dancers perform the Ramayana epic, silhouetted against the sunset over the ocean. Fire dancing, monkey warriors, and drama — all on a clifftop amphitheater. This is Bali's most unforgettable performance.

days.title: Uluwatu Beach Day — Padang Padang & Suluban
days.description: Explore the hidden beaches of the Bukit Peninsula — squeeze through cliff caves, surf perfect barrels, and discover Bali's most dramatic coastline.

activities.name: 🏖️ Padang Padang Beach
activities.description: Made famous by the movie 'Eat Pray Love' — a small, gorgeous beach accessed through a narrow cave in the cliff. The turquoise water is ridiculously clear. Small but perfectly formed, with great body surfing waves. Hidden beneath towering cliffs, accessed through a cave and narrow rock passages at low tide. This is where Uluwatu's famous left-hand surf break is. Even if you don't surf, the cave entrance and cliff-framed ocean views are worth the visit.

activities.name: 🍻 Uluwatu Bar Hop
activities.description: Uluwatu's nightlife is more chill than Canggu's — think sunset cocktails turning into late-night beach vibes. Hit up El Kabron for Mediterranean cliff-edge drinks, or keep it budget at the local warungs along Jl. Labuan Sait.

days.title: Uluwatu to Sidemen — The Road Less Traveled
days.description: Leave the beaches for Bali's most authentic rice terrace valley — Sidemen. Zero tourists, stunning views of Mount Agung, and genuine Balinese village life.

activities.name: 🛵 Epic Ride: Uluwatu to Sidemen
activities.description: A 3-hour cross-island ride through Bali's heart. The landscape shifts from arid cliffs to lush jungle to dramatic rice valleys with Mount Agung towering behind. Stop at Goa Lawah (Bat Cave Temple) on the coast en route. Temple built around a cave filled with thousands of bats. It's eerie, atmospheric, and sacred. The cave supposedly tunnels all the way to Besakih Temple. Quick 30-min stop.

days.title: Sidemen Rice Terraces & Village Life
days.description: A full day immersed in Sidemen's rice paddies, weaving villages, and the authentic rhythm of Balinese village life.

activities.name: 🌾 Rice Terrace Trek with Local Guide
activities.description: Hire a local guide (or go solo) for a 3-4 hour trek through Sidemen's magnificent rice terraces. Cross bamboo bridges, walk through working paddies, and visit small temples hidden among the fields. The guide will explain the subak irrigation system and daily rituals. Sidemen is famous for its endek and songket weaving traditions. Visit a family workshop to see ikat weaving on traditional looms — a painstaking art where each thread is dyed before weaving. Beautiful scarves and fabrics available to buy directly from the weavers.

days.title: Besakih Mother Temple & Tirta Gangga Water Palace
days.description: Visit Bali's holiest and largest temple complex, then explore a stunning water palace before heading to the quiet fishing village of Amed.

activities.name: 🛕 Pura Besakih (Mother Temple of Bali)
activities.description: Bali's largest and most important Hindu temple complex — 23 separate temples on the slopes of Mount Agung. Dating from the 14th century, it's the spiritual center of Balinese Hinduism. The tiered shrines ascending the mountain are awe-inspiring. A stunning 1946 water palace built by the last King of Karangasem. Ornate fountains, demon statues, stepping stones across fish-filled pools, and lush gardens. You can swim in the sacred spring-fed pool. It's magical and barely crowded.

days.title: Amed — Snorkeling, Shipwreck & Slow Living
days.description: Explore Amed's incredible underwater world — snorkel a Japanese shipwreck, drift through coral gardens, and embrace the art of doing absolutely nothing.

activities.name: 🤿 Japanese Shipwreck Snorkeling
activities.description: A WW2-era Japanese fishing boat rests in shallow water just 50 meters from shore. You can snorkel right over it — coral has colonized the wreck and it's now home to hundreds of colorful fish. No boat needed, no guide needed — just walk in from the beach. World-class snorkeling directly from shore. A sloping coral reef with incredible diversity — clownfish, parrotfish, sea turtles if you're lucky. The water is crystal clear and warm. You could spend hours just floating here.

days.title: Amed Sunrise & Tulamben USAT Liberty Wreck
days.description: Catch a spectacular sunrise over Lombok, then snorkel the famous USAT Liberty — a massive WW2 shipwreck right off the beach in Tulamben.

activities.name: 🌅 Amed Sunrise
activities.description: Amed faces east — directly toward Lombok's Mount Rinjani. Set an alarm for 5:30 AM and watch the sun rise over the Lombok Strait from your beachfront bungalow. One of the most stunning sunrises in Bali. The most famous dive/snorkel site in Bali. A 120-meter WW2 US Army transport ship torpedoed in 1942, now resting 5-30 meters deep and accessible from shore. Even snorkelers can see much of the wreck — it starts at just 3 meters depth. Massive schools of fish, giant barrel sponges, and the eerie outline of a warship make this unforgettable.

days.title: Amed to Lovina — North Coast Vibes
days.description: Cross to Bali's quiet north coast. Black sand beaches, dolphin-watching territory, and zero tourist crowds. This is the Bali that existed before Instagram.

activities.name: 🚗 Drive to Lovina via Air Sanih
activities.description: Scenic coastal drive through fishing villages. Stop at Air Sanih freshwater springs — natural pools right by the ocean. Arrive Lovina by afternoon. Walk the black sand beach as the sun drops behind the Java Sea. Outrigger boats line the shore. Cold Bintang from a beach warung.

days.title: Dolphins at Dawn & Banjar Hot Springs
days.description: Pre-dawn dolphin watching in traditional outrigger boats, then soak in volcanic hot springs surrounded by jungle. The north coast's greatest hits in one day.

activities.name: 🐬 Sunrise Dolphin Watching
activities.description: Board an outrigger jukung boat at 6 AM. Pods of spinner dolphins leap through golden morning light. It's touristy but genuinely magical. Volcanic hot springs carved into lush jungle. Three tiers of pools with dragon-mouth spouts. Incredibly relaxing after an early morning on the water.

days.title: Sekumpul Waterfall & Munduk
days.description: The most spectacular waterfall in Bali — hidden in a jungle canyon. Then on to Munduk, a misty mountain village with coffee plantations and zero nightlife. Pure tranquility.

activities.name: 💧 Sekumpul Waterfall
activities.description: A steep 30-minute trek through jungle and rice paddies leads to Bali's tallest, most dramatic waterfall. Twin cascades plunging 80m into a turquoise pool. Worth every drop of sweat. Afternoon stroll through coffee and clove plantations. The mountain air smells incredible. Watch beans being sorted and roasted, and sample the results.

days.title: Munduk Waterfalls & Twin Lakes
days.description: A day of Munduk's hidden waterfalls and the mystical twin lakes — Tamblingan and Buyan, surrounded by pristine jungle. Peak Bali nature vibes.

activities.name: 💧 Munduk Waterfall & Golden Valley
activities.description: Morning trek to Munduk Waterfall through clove plantations. Less touristy than Sekumpul, more intimate. The Golden Valley trail connects multiple smaller falls. Two volcanic crater lakes separated by a thin strip of jungle. Paddle a traditional canoe across Tamblingan's mirror-still waters. Spiritual and stunning.

days.title: Munduk to Seminyak — Beach Club Return
days.description: Descend from the mountains back to the coast. Seminyak brings the nightlife, boutique shopping, and sunset cocktails — a jarring but welcome contrast to Munduk's silence.

activities.name: 🚗 Drive to Seminyak
activities.description: 2.5-hour scenic drive from the mountains to the beach. Watch the landscape shift from jungle to rice paddies to urban sprawl. Drop bags, hit the beach. Seminyak's wide sandy shore is prime sunset territory. Bean bags, cocktails, and fire dancers as the sun drops.

days.title: Seminyak Shopping & Spa Day
days.description: Retail therapy and a Balinese massage. After weeks of adventure, your body deserves pampering and your wardrobe deserves an upgrade from sweaty hiking gear.

activities.name: 🛍️ Seminyak Boutique Shopping
activities.description: Jl. Kayu Aya (Eat Street) and surrounding lanes are packed with indie boutiques, surf shops, and artisan goods. Great for gifts and clothes. 2-hour traditional Balinese massage with flower bath. After weeks of trekking, this is non-negotiable. Budget Bali spas are world-class.

days.title: Nusa Penida Day Trip — Kelingking & Angel's Billabong
days.description: The day trip everyone comes to Bali for. Kelingking Beach's T-Rex cliff, Crystal Bay's turquoise water, and Angel's Billabong's natural infinity pool. Exhausting but absolutely worth it.

activities.name: ⛴️ Fast Boat to Nusa Penida
activities.description: 30-minute speedboat from Sanur. Bumpy but fast. Book the day before. Arrive at Toya Pakeh port. The money shot. A massive cliff shaped like a T-Rex head plunging into impossibly blue water. The hike down to the beach is brutal (45 min, steep, hot) but optional — the viewpoint is the main event.

days.title: Canggu Surf & Echo Beach Sunset
days.description: Bali's hipster surf hub. Try your hand at surfing, eat at healthy cafés, and watch the sunset from Echo Beach with a Bintang in hand.

activities.name: 🏄 Surf Lesson at Batu Bolong
activities.description: Beginner-friendly beach break. 2-hour lesson with board rental. Even if you've never surfed, you'll be standing by the end. Probably. Hit the famous Canggu cafés — smoothie bowls, avocado toast, specialty coffee. It's a cliché but they're genuinely good.

days.title: Tanah Lot Temple & Rice Terrace Walk
days.description: Bali's most photographed temple — perched on a rock in the ocean, only accessible at low tide. Combine with a peaceful rice terrace walk through Tabanan's gorgeous paddies.

activities.name: 🌾 Jatiluwih Rice Terraces (UNESCO)
activities.description: UNESCO-listed rice terraces stretching endlessly across volcanic hillsides. Way less crowded than Tegallalang and arguably more beautiful. The trek takes 1-3 hours depending on your route. Sea temple silhouetted against a burning sunset sky. The temple sits on a rock formation in the surf. At low tide, you can walk out and get blessed by the priests. At any tide, the sunset is unforgettable.

days.title: Uluwatu Cliffs & Kecak Fire Dance
days.description: Return to the Bukit Peninsula for the grand finale. Uluwatu Temple's clifftop drama and the legendary Kecak fire dance at sunset — pure Bali spectacle.

activities.name: 🏖️ Padang Padang Beach Morning
activities.description: The Eat Pray Love beach. Squeeze through a narrow cave opening to reach a tiny, perfect cove. Great for a morning swim and sunbathe. Clifftop temple 70m above the Indian Ocean. Monkeys roam everywhere (watch your stuff). At sunset, the open-air amphitheater hosts the Kecak fire dance — 50+ men chanting in unison while a dancer performs in firelight. Absolutely mesmerizing.

days.title: Last Full Day — Seminyak Farewell
days.description: Your last full day in paradise. No agenda, no alarm. Sleep in, wander, eat your favorites one more time, and soak it all in.

activities.name: 💆 Final Spa Session
activities.description: One last Balinese massage. You've earned it. Spring Spa does an incredible 90-minute deep tissue for the price of a coffee back home. Pick up anything you missed. Kuta Art Market for cheap souvenirs, Seminyak boutiques for quality pieces.

days.title: Departure — Selamat Tinggal, Bali 🌺
days.description: The end of an incredible 35-day journey. From volcanic sunrises to ocean sunsets, temple ceremonies to fire dances, $2 meals to life-changing experiences. Bali gave you everything.

activities.name: ✈️ Airport Transfer
activities.description: Grab transport to Ngurah Rai International Airport. Give yourself plenty of time — Bali traffic is unpredictable, especially on the Seminyak-airport corridor.

editorialSummary: An epic month-long Bali adventure built for a solo traveler who craves adventure, incredible food, deep relaxation, and vibrant nightlife — all for under $1,000. From rice terraces to volcanic sunrises, hidden waterfalls to beach clubs, this itinerary covers every corner of the Island of the Gods.
